0022600130.text: The Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home, 4th in the Southwest and 11th in the West) host the Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West) in the Spurs' fourth game of the season. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs swept all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
